object_description: long, low three-storey slab with patios and a partially sunken base
design_condition: The building follows Cours Roger-Bonvin near the roundabout to free the northeastern park, while its sports areas interrupt the broader connection between the course and the Ferme-Asile.

positive.statement: The entrance square has a strong connection to the building and a generous covered entrance.
The generous interior street offers interesting educational opportunities.
The shallow patios provide attractive daylight to classrooms while preserving sufficient privacy.
The flexible slab-and-column structure supports varied appropriation of the platforms.
The architectural language gives the school strength and character.
The broad horizontal lines help conceal the large scale of the building.
The project presents an open and welcoming image toward a changing neighborhood.

negative.statement: The corner clearances seem insufficient to provide adequate connections to the outside given the size of the floor plates.
Variations in scale would be desirable to provide more intimate spaces.
Accessibility for people with reduced mobility is not guaranteed for the aula stage.
The structural challenges concern absorbing loads above the gymnasiums and aula.
The sports areas interrupt the strong link between Cours Roger-Bonvin and the Ferme-Asile.
